howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.description: From concept to deployment in four simple steps. Build your perfect POS system without writing a single line of code.

step1.title: Choose Your Modules
step1.description: Select from our extensive library of pre-built modules including inventory management, sales tracking, customer management, and more.

step2.title: Customize Your System
step2.description: Tailor each module to your specific needs. Adjust workflows, add custom fields, and configure permissions to match your business.

step3.title: Configure & Test
step3.description: Set up your storage preferences (cloud or local), integrate with existing systems, and test everything in our sandbox environment.

step4.title: Deploy & Scale
step4.description: Export your complete POS system as a ready-to-install .exe file with licensing included. Deploy instantly and scale as you grow.

testimonial2.content: The customization options are incredible. We integrated our existing warehouse system and created custom reports in days, not months. The .exe export makes deployment a breeze.
